and one said: the whole world is sustained by their merit, and they are not sustained even by their own merit

Rav Yehuda: who are the stubborn-hearted? the foolish Gova'ei
Rav Yosef: know that it is so -- no convert has ever converted from among them
Rav Ashi: the people of the town of Mechasya are the stubborn-hearted
for they see the glory of the Torah twice a year, and no convert converts from among them
